name: Flux Channeler
oracle_text: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

needs.what: a full proliferate (701.34): the controller chooses any number of permanents and/or players that have counters (any controller, opponents included), then each chosen one gets another counter of each kind already on it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The existing `proliferate` op (options: `objects` only) is a simplification: it offers no choice and never reaches players (poison, experience, etc.) or opponents' permanents, so writing it would silently do something narrower than the printed text. The `spell_cast` trigger with a noncreature filter is expressible; only the proliferate itself is blocked.
